SearchAsync starts progress and ETA tasks that loop on IsBusy; references are not awaited in the reviewed method, and SetBusy(false) is not in a finally covering the search and automatic marking. A non-cancellation exception can leave busy state and reporter loops active; source-only.

CollectionChanged handlers subscribe on Add and unsubscribe on Remove but do not detach items on Reset/Clear. This is not by itself proof of retained objects because event ownership/lifetimes matter; stale objects retained elsewhere can still invoke callbacks.

Completed-search duplicate count uses DuplicateCount, but displayed byte size sums every returned group member including the retained representative; it is total grouped bytes rather than reclaimable duplicate bytes.
Directory add/remove/reorder commands use IsBusy guards; exclusion-directory selection is invoked inside Task.Run before busy is set. Full picker/UI threading qualification remains unread.
